name: Stardew Valley
description: A farming and life-simulation game combining farming, crafting, relationships, exploration, fishing and optional cave combat.
intended_use: For players who enjoy self-directed routines, collecting, building up a farm and choosing among many small goals.
audience_or_context: A broad-audience game rather than an ND-specific product. It is catalogued by play characteristics so people can judge whether its structure suits them.
limitations: The in-game day clock can create time pressure even though longer-term goals are largely self-directed.
Cave combat, audiovisual effects and the number of simultaneous possible goals may not suit every player.
cost_or_access_notes: This is a commercial game; price and platform availability vary.
conflicts_of_interest: The official game site is a first-party source for product identity and features and has a commercial interest in the game.

provenance.method: Official game information checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records play characteristics and access without inferring therapeutic or neurodivergence-specific benefit.
